user.title: Add an AD35 screen
user.description: Automatically add a new screen, recover a previous save, or use a temporary code, pairing file or manual details.

confirm.title: Add {name}
confirm.description: Confirm that this screen may connect to {origin}. Next, authorize in HA, choose screen items or weather, and explicitly save your selection. No screen interaction is needed.

select.title: Choose screen entities
select.description:
Search and select up to 64 screen items and one optional weather entity, or leave both empty. An empty screen remains bound to HA and items can be added later. Panels using automatic HTTPS onboarding require firmware 2.7.2 or later to save an empty selection. Firmware 2.6.0 adds sensors, binary sensors, locks, cameras and vacuums. Only this screen’s authorized catalog is selectable. Sensors display state only; cameras show still images with manual refresh.

Home layout: choose positions 1–6 only from the screen items selected above. Automatic keeps the saved order and appends newly selected items. All remaining items are retained, with weather separate. Names follow HA entity names. Review the items and home order, confirm and submit once to save.

data.confirm_selection: Confirm saving these screen items and home order

reconfigure.title: Choose entities again for {name}
reconfigure.description: This screen is already bound. Confirm reauthorization and a new entity selection for the same HA origin, {origin}. If the original HA entry is missing, a successful save restores it. The existing binding is kept until the new selection is saved. No screen interaction is needed.

credentials.title: Connect to the AD35 screen
credentials.description: Screen MAC: {mac}. Enter its individual connection key and the origin of this HA instance reachable by both the screen and your browser. Discovery details are verified over the encrypted connection. Keys are never shown again; you can retry an incorrect key.

manual.title: Enter device details manually
manual.description: Enter the screen address, MAC, its individual connection key, and the origin of this HA instance reachable by the screen. Requires stable firmware 2.1.2 or newer. Complete setup entirely in HA.

pairing_file.title: Import the screen pairing file
pairing_file.description: Choose the .ad35 or .json pairing file supplied with your screen and check the HA origin reachable by both the screen and your browser. Submitting connects this screen and starts HA authorization; you then choose entities and explicitly save. An already-bound screen first asks you to confirm reconfiguration with the same HA. No screen interaction is needed.

connection.title: Retry the screen connection
connection.description: Pairing details are retained temporarily, so there is no need to upload again. Check the screen address and this HA origin, then retry, or select “Choose another pairing file” to replace it.

pin_start.title: Start temporary-code pairing
pin_start.description: Check the HA origin and submit. The screen will show an 8-digit temporary code; no screen touch is needed. Requires firmware 2.2.0 or newer. Already-bound screens normally keep this feature closed; use Reconfigure on the existing entry.

pin.title: Enter the temporary screen code
pin.description: Enter all 8 digits shown on the screen, including any leading zeros. The temporary code lasts up to 120 seconds and establishes this secure connection. Next, authorize in HA and choose the entities to display.

auto.title: Add the screen automatically
auto.description: With firmware 2.3.1 or later, an unbound screen stays available for setup while connected to Wi-Fi, including after a restart. Check this HA origin, confirm and continue to HA authorization, entity selection and saving. No code, file or screen confirmation is needed. Firmware 2.3.0 still requires setup within five minutes of saving Wi-Fi on the screen. A trusted device certificate is required. From firmware 2.4.0, this HA can also check and manually install firmware from the device’s fixed release source; installation is never automatic. From firmware 2.5.0, you may also upload a device-specific local firmware file in HA and explicitly confirm installation after review.

data.confirm: Allow this screen to connect and let this HA manage displayed entities and vendor firmware updates

recover.title: Recover a saved screen setup
recover.description: Verify the screen using recovery credentials already stored on this HA. This reads the saved binding and does not repeat a save. Enter the current screen address. If an interrupted attempt never saved and the screen remains unbound, you can explicitly start authorization again; this never clears an existing binding. If reconnection of an existing entry was interrupted, verified recovery updates that same entry and preserves its history without repeating the save.

data.confirm: Verify and recover this screen entry
data.restart_uncommitted: Start authorization again only if the screen has not saved a binding

reconnect.title: Reconnect {name}
reconnect.description: The screen was unbound locally. Keep this HA entry and its history. Check the address and confirm, then authorize the same HA origin ({origin}), choose screen items or weather and explicitly save. The entry credentials change only after a verified save. An existing screen binding is never replaced anonymously.

data.confirm_reconnect: Reconnect this screen and keep its existing HA entry

progress.wait_screen: Preparing authorization over the encrypted connection. No screen interaction is needed.
progress.load_catalog: Authorizing the screen and loading your available entities.
progress.save: Saving on the screen. Wait for confirmation; cancellation cannot undo a save.

error.recovery_mismatch: The saved screen binding does not match this recovery record. No configuration was changed; check the original HA entry.
error.home_order_not_selected: Home positions must use screen items selected above. Choose Automatic to keep the current order.
error.home_order_duplicate: Each entity can occupy only one home position.
error.home_order_position_unavailable: A home position cannot exceed the number of selected screen items. Leave later positions on Automatic.
error.reconnect_confirmation_required: Confirm reconnection, then complete authorization and screen item selection.
error.reconnect_required: The screen was unbound. Reconnect from the existing AD35 entry’s reauthentication prompt or Reconfigure. Do not delete the device.
error.reconnect_successful: Reconnected; the existing HA entry and history were retained.
error.empty_selection_requires_firmware: Clearing all screen items and weather requires panel firmware 2.7.2 or later. Upgrade the panel first; the saved selection remains unchanged.

update_requires_firmware.message: HA firmware updates require device firmware 2.4.0 or newer. First upgrade through the existing maintenance method.

update_not_configured.message: This screen has no configured firmware release service. The current version is shown, but updates cannot be checked or installed yet.

update_not_ready.message: The screen is temporarily busy or offline. Wait for its current operation to finish and try again.

update_busy.message: A device operation is already in progress. Wait before checking or installing again.

update_no_candidate.message: No installable update is available. Check for updates first.

update_candidate_mismatch.message: The checked release changed or expired. Check again and review the offered version before installing.

update_request_mismatch.message: The device rejected a conflicting update request. No install was retried.

update_check_failed.message: Unable to check the firmware release service. Try checking again later.

update_manifest_invalid.message: The release manifest failed validation. No firmware was installed.

update_download_auth_failed.message: The device could not authenticate with its release service. Contact the device provider.

update_update_failed.message: The firmware update failed. Check the device status before trying again.

update_unknown_operation.message: The firmware does not support HA update commands. Upgrade through the existing maintenance method.

update_invalid_credential.message: The device rejected this HA binding credential. The update was not authorized.

update_invalid_payload.message: The device rejected the update request format. Update the matching integration and firmware.

update_check_timeout.message: The check did not finish in time. Its request was not repeated; check the device status before retrying.

update_result_unknown.message: The update result could not be confirmed within ten minutes. No install was repeated. Wait for the screen to reconnect and verify its current version before trying again.

update_invalid_options.message: Only the currently offered firmware can be installed. Version selection and firmware backup are not supported.

update_unavailable.message: The authenticated device connection is unavailable. Check its network and try again.

identity_mismatch.message: The connected device does not match this HA entry. No update was authorized.

commissioning_certificate_error.message: The device TLS certificate is not trusted or does not match its MAC. Certificate verification cannot be bypassed.

invalid_response.message: The device returned an invalid update response. No request was repeated.

invalid_credential.message: The saved HA binding credential is invalid. Check the existing device binding.

update_interrupted.message: Another maintenance operation interrupted the firmware operation. Check the device status, then check for updates again.

local_upload.title: Local firmware file
local_upload.description: Select the OTA .bin supplied for this screen. The file is validated and shown for review before anything is written. Do not select a factory image. The upload is removed and its in-memory copy is cleared when this flow ends.
